name: Qvalia
summary: Peppol e-invoicing and business messaging platform whose Enrichment API classifies invoice lines and product lists against UNSPSC through a documented REST endpoint (up to 55 products per request, asynchronous, result per product id, possibly null or above commodity level). Measured keyless: the sandbox categorisation endpoint answers 401 JSON. The vendor also describes a Peppol MCP server with named tools but publishes no endpoint.

payments.notes: The Enrichment API is billed separately and enabled by Qvalia support; no public price for it was found. Connect plans (9 to 899 EUR a month) price messages, not classification. A free web UNSPSC search allows 5 searches a day, unlimited for 5 EUR a month.

agentAccess.notes: OpenAPI declares an Authorization header API key or a JWT from the Account API. Measured 2026-11-11 06:0xZ, no credentials: POST to the sandbox categorisation path gave 401 E_UNAUTHORIZED_CLIENT; production gave 401 text. No MCP endpoint is published.

jobs.summary: Vendor's claim: UNSPSC classification of each invoice line and of catalogue and price-list items, through the Enrichment API or in its spend analytics. Neither job measure (accuracy, share of spend classified) is published; the API documents null results and predictions above commodity level.
